transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I came in because... well, ever since I moved into this busted-up room I'm renting, things have just been going downhill. I'm snapping at people all the time. I end up staying up half the night trying to fix leaks or get the heat working, and then... then I'm dragging myself into work late. And once I'm there, I'm messing up stuff I normally handle with no problem. It's just getting to be too much.
Did these problems start after you moved into that room?

Yeah. I was doing pretty normal before I moved into that place. Um, it all really started within the first couple weeks... right after I found all the water damage and realized the heat wasn't working right.
When you try to sleep at night, do you have trouble falling asleep?

Not really. I mean, I work construction all day, so I'm pretty beat by the time I get home. Once I actually lay down, I pass out pretty fast. 

It's just... like I said, I don't usually get to bed until way late because I'm up messing with the pipes or trying to get the heater going. So I don't really have trouble falling asleep, I just don't get enough of it before my alarm goes off.
Since moving into that room, have you been feeling down or depressed?
No, not really depressed. I mean, I'm stressed out and pissed off about the whole situation with the room, but I wouldn't say I feel down or sad. Just frustrated that I have to deal with it all.
Since moving into that room, have you been feeling unusually anxious or worried?

Not really. I wouldn't call it anxiety. I'm not sitting around feeling nervous or worrying about what's gonna happen, you know? It's more just... I'm stressed because of the actual physical work I have to put into dealing with the place every single night. It's a massive headache, but no, I don't feel anxious.
If your housing situation were fixed, do you think your problems at work would go away?

Yeah, I really think they would. I mean, the whole housing mess hasn't ended yet. I'm still living in that room, and I'm still dealing with all the repairs and the landlord every day. 

So it's not like... this isn't something that just kept going long after the problem was over, you know? I'm still right in the middle of it. If that situation was actually fixed and I could just get a normal night's sleep, yeah, I'm pretty sure I'd be totally fine at work again.
Is the room you’re renting currently unsafe or not adequately heated?

No, it's not unsafe or anything. And the heat works fine. It's just... well, like I said, it's all the repairs and dealing with the landlord that's the problem. But as far as being dangerous or freezing, no, it's nothing like that.
